subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Six nights at local 5-star hotels from Chongqing through Qianjiang and Fenghuang to Zhangjiajie. See Liziba Station, Fenghuang Ancient Town and Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (the Avatar mountains) by the Bailong Lift, plus the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge. Flights are with Air China.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 25–Dec 1 2026 to Nov 25–Dec 1 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Chongqing – Qianjiang
items: Fly Manila to Chongqing (CA482 01:50/05:40; from Oct 28: 02:25/06:20); meet the guide.
Visit Liziba Station, where light rail runs through residential buildings.
Visit the People’s Great Hall of Chongqing (outside view).
Visit Kuixing Building (the 22nd floor that feels like the 1st).
Night view of Hongya Cave.
Transfer to hotel. Meals: X/L/D.

itinerary.title: Chongqing – Qianjiang – Fenghuang
items: Hotel breakfast.
Transfer to Qianjiang (3.5 hrs); visit Zhuoshui Ancient Town.
After lunch, transfer to Fenghuang (3-4 hrs).
Visit Fenghuang Ancient Town (Tuojiang River, Wanming Tower, Stone Slabs Street, Bar Street) and its night view. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Fenghuang – Zhangjiajie
items: Hotel breakfast.
Transfer to Zhangjiajie (3 hrs).
Visit 72 Wonder Tower (outside view).
Optional tour 1: Tianmen Mountain (cable car, glass skywalk, Tianmen Cave), USD 85 per person.
Optional tour 2: Tianmen Fox-Lady Show, USD 70 per person. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit a Chinese medicine shop.
Visit Zhangjiajie National Forest Park, up and down by Bailong Lift: No.1 Bridge, Breath-taking Platform, Avatar Hallelujah Mountain and Tianzi Mountain.
Back to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit a latex store.
Visit Golden Whip Stream and Water Around Four Gates.
Tea tasting at a tea shop or a visit to a silk shop.
Visit Grand Canyon C Line Glass Bridge (VR experience included).
Back to hotel. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Zhangjiajie – Qianjiang
items: Hotel breakfast.
Visit a jewelry store.
Transfer to Qianjiang (3-4 hrs) and check in.
Optional tour 3: Huanglong Cave (sightseeing boat included), USD 70 per person. Meals: B/L/D.

itinerary.title: Qianjiang – Chongqing – Manila
items: Hotel breakfast.
Transfer to Chongqing (3-4 hrs).
Visit Danzishi Old Street and Jiefangbei Pedestrian Street.
Visit Bayi Food Street (food at your own expense).
Transfer to airport; fly home (CA481 20:50/00:50+1; Nov-Dec: 21:30/01:20+1). Meals: B/L/X.

placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light-rail station where the train runs through a residential building, a famous photo spot.
placeDesc.People’s Great Hall of Chongqing: A large landmark hall in Chongqing modelled on traditional Chinese architecture, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Kuixing Building: A Chongqing building that feels like the 1st floor but is actually the 22nd floor, thanks to the hillside street.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stilted riverside building complex in Chongqing, famous for its night view.
placeDesc.Zhuoshui Ancient Town: An old river town in the Qianjiang area, visited on the way to Fenghuang.
placeDesc.Fenghuang Ancient Town: A riverside old town with stilt houses, Wanming Tower, Stone Slabs Street and a lively night scene.
placeDesc.72 Wonder Tower: A tall stilt-shaped building in Zhangjiajie, viewed from outside.
placeDesc.Zhangjiajie National Forest Park (Avatar: A national forest park of tall sandstone pillars, linked to the scenery of the Avatar movie.
placeDesc.Bailong Lift: A large outdoor glass elevator that carries visitors up the cliff face at Zhangjiajie.
placeDesc.Avatar Hallelujah Mountain: A floating-style sandstone peak in Zhangjiajie that is linked to the Avatar movie scenery.
placeDesc.Tianzi Mountain: A scenic peak area in the Zhangjiajie park, visited on the Bailong Lift day.
placeDesc.Golden Whip Stream: A scenic walking stream valley in Zhangjiajie, with the Water Around Four Gates viewpoint.
placeDesc.Grand Canyon Glass Bridge: A glass-bottomed bridge over a deep canyon near Zhangjiajie; the visit includes a VR experience.
placeDesc.Danzishi Old Street: An old street in Chongqing with traditional shops and food, visited on the last day.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei: Chongqing's central pedestrian shopping district with a landmark monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street known for local food, where meals are at your own expense.
